verdict.rationale: Apify supports exporting dataset results in multiple generic formats (CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML) via its client, but there is no evidence of developer-facing control over content-specific output formats like markdown, HTML, text, or frontmatter as would apply to a scraping/content tool. missing for 10: explicit markdown/HTML/text/frontmatter output options, documentation showing format selection for scraped content rather than just dataset export.
